name: Excel to CSV
summary: Convert an Excel .xlsx / .xls sheet to CSV locally in your browser.
description: Choose an Excel workbook, pick a sheet, and get CSV output you can copy. Parsing runs client-side with SheetJS — files are not uploaded.

faqs.question: Which formats are supported?
faqs.answer: .xlsx and legacy .xls workbooks that SheetJS can read in the browser.

faqs.question: What if there are multiple sheets?
faqs.answer: Pick the sheet from the dropdown after the file loads.

faqs.question: Is my spreadsheet uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Reading and conversion run entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: Need a table preview?
faqs.answer: Copy the CSV into CSV Viewer / Table.
